content.title: Guardians vs. Mariners FREE STREAM today: Where to watch MLB season opener
content.text: If you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.SEATTLE – Baseball is officially back! The Cleveland Guardians are out west to open the season against AL MVP runner-up Cal Raleigh and the Seattle Mariners tonight at T-Mobile Park. This MLB season opener is available on multiple streaming services for free.How do I watch Guardians baseball for free today?This game will broadcast live on CleGuardians.TV and Mariners.TV at 10:10 p.m. Eastern. (7:10 p.m. Pacific). There are two ways to catch this game free. Fans who have parted ways with their local cable provider can watch at no cost by utilizing a free trial from DIRECTV, which also offers $35 off your first month. FuboTV has a free trial and $25 off your first month. All columns visible (no scrolling needed)Cleveland GuardiansCleveland enters the season looking to finally find an answer for its lackluster offense, which posted a franchise-low .226 batting average last season, one of the worst in baseball. Jose Ramirez and Steven Kwan remain the cornerstones of a franchise in desperate need of some firepower. Despite those offensive shortcomings, the Guardians made history by erasing a 15.5-game deficit to stun the Detroit Tigers and win their second straight AL Central crown. Detroit had the last laugh, eliminating Cleveland in the Wild Card round of the postseason. It will be a homecoming of sorts for Guardians manager Stephen Vogt, who resides in Olympia, Washington, and was a bullpen coach for Seattle. After the rollercoaster season in 2025, there is renewed optimism that a youthful core is the missing piece to a deep run in October. The pitching staff looks ready to unload, beginning with Tanner Bibee taking the mound tonight in Seattle. Guardians players to watchJose Ramirez The Guardians’ centerpiece tallied 30 home runs with 85 RBI and a .283 batting average. His .863 OPS was 14th in baseball last year.Chase DeLauterAll eyes will be on the rookie after a superb spring where he slashed .459/.535/.838 with three home runs, five doubles and six walks. Kyle Manzardo Playing in his first full season at the Major League level, Manzardo wowed at times during the 2025 campaign, posting 27 home runs with 70 RBI and a .234 batting average. Watch Guardians vs. Mariners for free on DIRECTVSeattle Mariners The Mariners delivered a memorable postseason run, pushing the Toronto Blue Jays to the limit in Game 7 of the ALCS. Seattle captured the AL West for the first time in 24 years and solidified itself as a perennial pennant contender for the future, falling just eight outs short of its first World Series appearance. The team features five All-Stars in the past two seasons expected at the top half of the batting order, including Cal Raleigh, Randy Arozarena and Josh Naylor. Tonight’s game is the only Opening Day matchup that pits two division winners against each other. Mariners players to watch Cal Raleigh Raleigh led MLB in home runs with 60 and powered in 125 RBI, which was third in baseball. He also posted a .247 batting average and .948 OPS, which ranked fifth in the Majors. Josh Naylor The former Guardian had his moments with the Mariners last year, tallying 20 home runs and 92 RBI with a .295 batting average and .816 OPS. Randy ArozarenaArozarena belted 27 home runs with 76 RBI and a .238 batting average last season. Watch Guardians vs. Mariners for free on FuboTVToday’s pitching matchupCLE Tanner Bibee (12-11, 4.24 ERA) vs. SEA Logan Gilbert (6-6, 3.44)Bibee took a step back with a mediocre showing in 2025. Leading the team in innings pitched, he racked up 162 strikeouts but posted a career-worst ERA and 1.23 WHIP, which was 27th in baseball. Bibee allowed 27 home runs last season. He sharpened his craft down the regular season stretch, simmering in four September starts. Bibee allowed a 1.30 ERA with 26 strikeouts and five walks in that span of 27 and two third innings of work. The Guardians have a plethora of options in the bullpen, including Matt Festa, Tim Herrin and Erik Sabrowski. Hunter Gaddis will not be available as he begins the season on the injured list with a right forearm strain.Gilbert notched 173 strikeouts and posted a 1.03 WHIP in a shortened season that saw him out for nearly two months with a Grade 2 right flexor strain. He became a staple of their rotation during their deep playoff run, including two perfect innings in Seattle’s historic 15-game marathon against the Detroit Tigers in Game 5 of the ALDS. The Mariners’ bullpen also packs a punch, headlined by closer Andres Munoz. Gabe Speier, Eduard Bazardo and Matt Brash are the main core. Seattle will also integrate Jose A.
